native_mechanisms: A growing sailor-chain hung between fire and wall makes every shadow depend on the whole row, not just the newest knot.
A mark's own pebble-count sets the incense-smoke's swing, bending the firelight before it lands.
The wet-clay print taken from the settled shadow, hardened in the stream and read by its ridges, is the only thing kept as the token.
core_technique: Multiply-free absorption loop: XOR each byte/32-byte block into the state, then rotate by a data-derived distance (the mark's own low bits + a fixed offset, per-lane via AVX2 variable shifts) with a second data-selected rotation and cross-lane permute coupling, closed by an O(1) splitmix64 finalizer.
